## 01 EcoPro BM Unveils Korea Solid-State Battery Roadmap
EcoPro BM, a Korean company, has unveiled its solid-state battery roadmap, targeting production by 2027. This move marks a significant step in the commercialization of solid-state battery technology, which is expected to revolutionize the electric vehicle industry. According to [Chosunbiz](https://news.google.), the company's solid-state battery technology has shown promising results, with improved safety, energy density, and charging speeds.

## 02 Whistleblower Alleges Finnish Startup’s Solid-State Battery Isn’t What It Claims
A whistleblower has come forward, alleging that a Finnish startup's solid-state battery technology is not what it claims to be. This raises concerns about the validity of the technology and the potential consequences for investors and partners. ## 03 QuantumScape Advances PowerCo Tie Up And Nasdaq Shift
QuantumScape, a leading solid-state battery developer, has made progress in its partnerships and stock listing. The company has advanced its tie-up with PowerCo and is shifting its stock listing to Nasdaq. According to [simplywall.st](https://news.google.), the company's progress is a positive sign for the solid-state battery industry, which is expected to play a crucial role in the transition to electric vehicles.
